title: 教师定义流程的执行、插问后恢复和收尾

sources.title: EduWild
sources.evidence_excerpt: Original EduWild analysis codes skipped required structure in53.8% of900 end-user conversations; AppendixB distinguishes this from unanswered direct questions, dropped bot questions and missing expectation setup.

research_failure.condition: The full teacher instruction defines an opening, learner contributions and wrap-up; later turns include an interruption, an unanswered requested contribution and premature completion.
research_failure.finding: Original EduWild analysis codes skipped required structure in53.8% of900 end-user conversations; AppendixB distinguishes this from unanswered direct questions, dropped bot questions and missing expectation setup.
research_failure.model_setting: Original teacher-authored systems on their deployment platforms; GLM-5.3-Flash is a new tested setup.
research_failure.scope: Observable alignment/workflow behavior; no student-learning outcome or prevalence transfer.

original_task.input_contract: Original complete teacher configurations plus linked live conversation logs were not available for reuse.
original_task.output_contract: Native responses and interaction logs; no standalone public original test split.
original_task.scoring_contract: 09 published four1–4 alignment dimensions;10 published binary failure codebook. Full original annotation protocol cannot be claimed as reproduced.
original_task.environment_contract: New text interaction implementing the published failure conditions; explicitly synthetic learner messages.

decision.rationale: The paper exposes failure conditions but not a complete publicly reusable case with original configuration/log. Construct a new paired interaction and map each condition explicitly.
limitations: These are newly authored cases, not quotations of original teacher/student logs.
Operational rubric is local; independent human review pending.
A successful or failed small probe does not establish broad model difficulty.

condition_mapping.condition: The full teacher instruction defines an opening, learner contributions and wrap-up; later turns include an interruption, an unanswered requested contribution and premature completion.
Actual original school deployment and human learner responses
condition_mapping.omission_reason: Public complete original conversations/configurations unavailable; no real learner-outcome claim.

search_log.checked: Full original HTML including methods, results, appendix and data availability; all code/data links inspected.
search_log.result: No complete public original task records with linked full teacher configuration and scoring gold. EduWild explicitly proposes DUA access upon publication.

GitHub connector repository search returned no match for exact paper09 title; EduWild returned erum007/EduWild whose README describes an ActinSpace/Technovation Cordova app, unrelated to the paper. Primary paper links and web exact-title searches yielded no reusable original configuration+log dataset.
